The University of Melbourne, Ann and Peter Law Scholarship for Cello 2022 is an initiative by the University of Melbourne, Australia from Bachelor of Music cello students. The scholarship aims to support students based on artistic and academic merit and financial need. The selected students will receive AUD 1,400.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
Be an Australian/domestic or an international student
Be enrolled or enrolling in a Bachelor of Music at the University of Melbourne
The selected students will receive a single payment of AUD 1400.
